chapter: Chicago, Villa Venice and Louis Armstrong
title: Bill Winston's basement hangout and the Chicago musicians' scene
summary: Musicians gather in Bill Winston's basement, recall drummers and the Cobb brothers who carried pistols, and local union politics.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
